data.name: Harishankar
data.gender_notes: Harishankar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: God Hari + Shankara (Lord of the mountains)
data.long_meaning: Harishankar is a combination of two Sanskrit words: Hari and Shankara. Hari means 'God' and Shankara means 'Lord of the mountains'. Thus, Harishankar is a name that represents the divine power of God, who is also considered the Lord of all mountains. The name Harishankar carries the meaning “God Hari + Shankara (Lord of the mountains)” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi, Telugu. Parents who choose Harishankar usually hope their child will grow to embody god hari + shankara (lord of the mountains) and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Harishankar is a name that symbolizes strength, power, and victory over all obstacles. It is believed that invoking the name of Harishankar can bring success, prosperity, and good fortune in all aspects of life.
data.etymology: Harishankar belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God Hari + Shankara (Lord of the mountains).”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Harishankar total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name 'Harishankar' holds rich cultural significance in Hinduism. It is a revered name in the Indian subcontinent, especially among those who follow the Hindu religion. Harishankar is often associated with religious pilgrimages to Hindu temples, particularly those located in or near mountainous regions. In various Hindu texts, Harishankar is mentioned as a form of Lord Shiva, who is believed to control the mountains and is the protector of the universe.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Harishankar signifies the acknowledgment of the divine presence in nature, particularly in the mountains. Harishankar represents the union of two essential aspects of the divine - Hari, the ultimate reality and source of all creation, and Shankara, the power of destruction and transformation. Thus, this name embodies the cycle of creation, preservation, and destruction that is the fundamental nature of the universe. Harboring the name Harishankar would instill a sense of reverence for the divine in nature and a deep appreciation for the cyclical order of existence.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Harishankar symbolizes the convergence of two supreme deities, Vishnu (Harish) and Shiva (Shankar), signifying the unity of preservation (Vishnu) and destruction (Shiva) in the cycle of creation and cosmic order.

historical_references.reference: Harishankar was a renowned Hindu philosopher, poet and theologian, who lived during the 13th to 14th century AD in India. He is best known for his works in the bhakti movement, specifically his compositions in the Marathi language. Harishankar's contributions significantly influenced the devotional literature in Maharashtra.

Harishankar Maharaj was a revered saint and saint-king of the Nath Panth, an ascetic order in medieval India. He was a disciple of Gorakhnath and ruled the Malwa region of present-day Madhya Pradesh from the 13th to the 14th century AD. Harishankar is remembered for his spiritual teachings and his contributions to the Nath tradition.

modern_usage.modern_context: Harishankar is a modern name that carries a rich cultural heritage. While it is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and represents the convergence of two powerful forces - Hari (Vishnu) and Shankara (Shiva), the name is also gaining popularity in modern contexts. On LinkedIn, Harishankar is seen as a name that resonates with spiritual values and entrepreneurial spirit. On Twitter, it is used to discuss various aspects of Hindu philosophy and to share motivational quotes. On Medium, Harishankar is a pen name for a popular blogger who writes about technology, spirituality, and entrepreneurship. The name is thus a powerful symbol of the intersection of spirituality, entrepreneurship, and technology in today's world.
